snippet.title: Ashes of the Singularity II  |  Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499790/Ashes_of_the_Singularity_II/

This highly anticipated sequel features a new faction, larger battles, advanced units, and a new campaign to lead humanity against hostile AI takeover.

In Ashes of the Singularity II, a massive real-time strategy game, command vast armies fighting for control of entire worlds. Control the forces of Earth, the mechanical AI Substrate, or the enigmatic Post-Human Coalition as you battle across the solar system in single player, cooperative multiplayer, or competitive multiplayer. After the technological singularity, only one form of life will survive.
